text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder has invited me to<n>watch her dance
lesson.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I appreciate you making the time for<n>this.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Your opinion will be really helpful to<n>me.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: One, two, three!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...Let's do that last section once more.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: She's giving the rehearsal her all, and<n>yet...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Sigh...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
After finishing the dance, she doesn't<n>seem
satisfied with her performance.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: The choreography for the chorus<n>isn't clicking.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I understand the rhythm perfectly<n>well, but I still
can't dance it as well<n>as the others.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Do you have any idea what I'm doing<n>wrong?
choice_data_list: What if you were more expressive?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Interesting. Perhaps I was too<n>focused on finesse.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Perhaps if I hit the beat with more<n>force...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I'll set aside the graceful imagery and<n>try
visualizing martial arts during the<n>main hook
instead.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It seems adding a bit of power to her<n>step did the
trick.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: You're right—that is a crucial aspect.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
In my efforts to perfect the individual<n>steps, I may
have refined away the<n>dance's personality.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Racing demands a healthy dose of<n>ambition, so the
same should hold<n>true for winning concerts.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I'll try to convey the true depths of<n>my feelings
which none of the others<n>can surpass.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... this might make me appear a<n>little bolder
than usual, don't you<n>think?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder returns to her dance<n>practice with
more pep in her step.
